name: investment.quotes

list.description: Read one qualified bounded QUOTED response, retaining unknown native total.

parameters.name: from-date
parameters.description: Native inclusive value-date start, YYYYMMDD; may equal to-date.

parameters.name: to-date
parameters.description: Native inclusive value-date end, YYYYMMDD; not before from-date.

get.description: Read the entire native quotation detail root with all sibling sections.

lookup.name: quotationOrderId
lookup.description: Native quotationOrderId from the unprojected QUOTED List row.

result_identity.description: Native nested quotationDetail.quotationId, matched exactly to lookup without copying or flattening.

purpose: Inspect native QUOTED records and full detail without changing negotiation or win state.

fields.name: quotationOrderId
fields.meaning: Native List identity; Get declares its distinct nested identity.

fields.name: valueDate
fields.meaning: Native value date selected by the query bounds.

fields.name: quote
fields.meaning: Native percentage quote retained without arithmetic or display conversion.

identity_description: One native quotationOrderId per List record; no synthetic root identity.
limitations: QUOTED only. One JSON POST /quotationAnalysis.json with rowStart=0, qualified pageSize=5000 and native timeZone=null; no offset loop, fallback width or fabricated total.

The accepted native whole-response contract applies to the explicit bounded query; reported_total remains null while observed arrivals and identity quality remain separate. Width5000 is not a demonstrated backend maximum.

All native records, types, order, unknown fields and exact amounts are retained. Duplicate/conflicting identities remain incomplete; strict refresh preserves earlier data on rejection and on complete-empty acquisition.
Native Get is form POST /queryQuotationOrder.json, preserving the entire baseResult.data root. Its quotationDetail.quotationId is validated before projection; no top-level ID is invented.

List --live --with-detail uses selected native quotationOrderId values and returns record/detail members. Separate unreturned history or child endpoints are unqueried; Get/combined never publish cache or Duckdog data.
No runtime Duckdog import contract is introduced.
